text:
Elena (Finance): following the postmortem—can we lock owners + concrete dates for the delayed-usage token overcount? lanes: eng investigation + short-term guard, billing corrections, and customer outreach. who takes what?

Tom (Eng): i'll own the engineering side. early signal points to reprocessed telemetry being re-ingested without idempotency, leading to inflated token totals. i'll produce a repro script and a small ingest dedupe patch for canary. ETA for repro + patch: 2026-04-08 18:00 UTC. i'll also add a nightly regression job that replays a small batch.

Sana (Billing): billing will take the invoice work. need CSV of impacted request_ids with customer_id + timestamp + token_delta. plan: map to invoices, draft credit memos, run a pilot of 25 invoices, then expand. target pilot: 2026-04-12 morning PST; full run after validation.

Leo (Support): support will prepare two templates (enterprise detailed + general notice) and a triage sheet. please provide affected enterprise list so we can proactively reach out. i'll also staff a shared inbox during the pilot run.

Elena (Finance): Tom please paste a lightweight query to extract suspicious requests so billing can start mapping.

Tom (Eng): quick query below (no PI):

```
SELECT r.request_id, r.customer_id, r.event_time, r.reported_tokens, est.estimated_tokens,
       r.reported_tokens - est.estimated_tokens AS token_delta
FROM reported_tokens r
JOIN estimate_cache est USING (request_id)
WHERE r.event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-07' AND '2026-04-07 23:59:59'
  AND (r.reported_tokens - est.estimated_tokens) > 35
ORDER BY token_delta DESC
LIMIT 800;
```

Tom (Eng): i'll upload CSV to s3://billing-incidents/2461357901/impacted.csv when done.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://billing-incidents/2461357901/impacted.csv uploaded by @tom-eng at 2026-04-08T09:22:10Z; rows=298; size=72KB

Sana (Billing): received the CSV. quick policy question: for invoices already paid, do we issue refunds or account credits? Elena please confirm the policy for this incident.

Elena (Finance): policy decision: refunds only on explicit customer request for amounts > $350; otherwise apply account credit. enterprise invoices get line-item adjustments. document in remediation notes.

Leo (Support): drafting templates now. will post draft links by 2026-04-09 11:00 PST. request an enterprise customer list from billing once mapping is done.

Tom (Eng): short-term mitigation: add a 12s dedupe window at ingestion and emit metric "ingest_duplicate_rate". i'll create a PagerDuty alert if daily duplicate rate > 0.25%. long-term: add idempotency keys and a safe-replay path.

Sana (Billing): mapping complete: ~94 invoices affected, 22 invoices > $1k. estimated total adj ~$15,900. prepping credit memos and will run pilot of 25 invoices on 2026-04-12 09:00 PST. posting owner+ETA table to remediation tracker in ~30m.

Elena (Finance): action summary:
- Tom (Eng): repro, canary dedupe, PD alert, nightly replay regression (due 2026-04-08 EOD)
- Sana (Billing): invoice mapping, credit memos, pilot run 2026-04-12 AM
- Leo (Support): comms templates + staffed triage during pilot (templates due 2026-04-09 11:00 PST)

Elena (Finance): also adding a weekly metering audit comparing reported_tokens vs estimate at invoice level to catch recurring patterns. Tom can you add a Grafana panel for that?

Tom (Eng): yes — will add dashboard and weekly job that emits an anomaly alert if invoice-level delta > 0.5%. will post the alert rule link after deploy.

Sana (Billing): pilot scheduled. will post pilot results and reconciliation CSV after run.

Leo (Support): acknowledged. will escalate any refund requests > $350 to Finance and keep a ticket log.

Elena (Finance): thank you. i'll track everything in the remediation tracker and update legal if customers request refunds. please update this thread when items complete. :white_check_mark:
